body.statement: In the adaptive-experiment framework of Freidling, Zhao, and Gao, Proposition 1 states that assumptions A1--A3 and selective validity under the corresponding conditional reference law imply superuniform selective \(p\)-values and selective type-I error control.  This validity implication does not require the statistic, selector, or action law to be imputable.

attestation.note: The proposition-level claim is recorded with the stable primary-paper handles; the directive-supplied distinction between validity and imputability is preserved.
